description: The parsing model at a trust boundary: converts what clients send and rejects everything outside the contract.
The immutable, typed object code works with after parsing; usually a frozen dataclass, never revalidated inside the process.

term: Lax at the edge, strict inside
description: Convert only where clients cannot send exact types; between your own services, a type mismatch is a bug that must fail loudly.
A generated JSON Schema for one published contract version; the count is event types times versions accepted at once.
A size cap checked before parsing, sized from the largest legitimate payload with headroom.
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
